versions.changelog:
Initial release of firefly-folder-organize: AI-powered assistant for organizing Firefly AI folder files.

- Enables local AI analysis for categorization, smart renaming, tagging, deduplication, and semantic file search.
- Provides endpoints to monitor analysis progress, queue status, and workspace overview.
- Supports generating, previewing, and applying virtual directory organization plans via natural workflow.
- Includes strict workflow and reply formatting rules for user interactions and error handling.
- Multi-language support for user notifications as per system/user language preference.
